item.title: BUA boss’ $500k promise: Gov’s aide raises alarm over ‘man in black’ who could appear at AFCON 2025
item.description: A Nigerian governor’s aide has issued a warning to the Super Eagles over a “man in black” following BUA boss’ $500k promise to the team at AFCON 2025.

item.title: What CAF said to Akor Adams after his tribute to DR Congo's 'Lumumba'
item.description: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) has sent a message to Akor Adams after his tribute to DR Congo's superfan Mboladinga 'Lumumba' after his goal vs Algeria.

item.title: AFCON 2025: Big blow for Nigeria as Super Eagles to miss 1 key player vs Morocco in semifinal
item.description: Nigeria faces a setback as captain Wilfred Ndidi misses the AFCON 2025 semifinal against Morocco due to injury and suspension, despite a strong quarterfinal victory.

item.title: Watch new video as Jarvis seemingly throws shades at Peller, people react
item.description: A video making the rounds on social media has captured the moment Jarvis Jadrolita threw shades at Peller. Netizens reacted massively to the video on TikTok.

item.title: Watch trending video as Oyinbo man laments bitterly about his Nigerian girlfriend
item.description: A video making the rounds on social media has captured the moment an oyinbo man lamented over the attitude of his wife who sees him as a professional photographer.

item.title: See photos of Nigerian graduate who appreciated ChatGPT on sign-out day
item.description: Photos of a Nigerian graduate who appreciated ChatGPT during his sign-out from the university have gone viral on the X app. Netizens reacted to his post.

item.title: Watch: Algeria players attack referee Issa Sy after losing to Nigeria
item.description: A video has emerged online of Algerian players confronting the match official after their 2-0 loss to Nigeria in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations quarter-final.

item.title: Knocks as US lawmaker reiterates fresh Donald Trump's threat to Nigeria
item.description: Nigerians have started reacting to the renewed threat on Nigeria by US President Donald Trump as a powerful lawmaker reiterated a major claim after Sokoto bombing.

item.title: Just in: Another air strike hits terrorists camp in top Northern state
item.description: NAF records fresh success as precision air strikes hit terrorists’ camp in Borno’s Timbuktu Triangle, destroying hideouts and reinforcing intelligence-led operations

item.title: AFCON 2025: Tinubu, Peter Obi, Kwankwaso others react as Nigeria beat Algeria 2:0
item.description: President Tinubu praises Nigeria's 2–0 victory over Algeria at AFCON 2025, celebrating team unity. Leaders Obi and Kwankwaso commend the Super Eagles' performance.
